response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rebate) AS mean_avg_rebate, AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate - o.avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_excess_net_fee_rate FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > o.avg_net_fee_rate
